# Three.js

Vendored Three.js **0.180.0** ES modules, installed from the official `three` npm package using npm's registry integrity verification. Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

`three.module.js` imports `three.core.js` from this directory. The MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. Local copies keep the game self-contained and playable offline; no CDN or runtime package installation is required.
